source_note: 关于序列极限的公开问题
callout_id: 关于序列极限的公开问题#8
statement_en: Let $G(x):I\to \mathbb{R}$ be a differentiable convex function, and let $r_n\in I$ be a sequence. Then $$\Delta^2 G(r_n)\geq G'(r_{n+1})\Delta^2 r_n.$$
callout_body: 令$G(x):I\to \mathbb{R}$是凸函数,并且可微,序列$r_n\in I$,则$$\Delta^2 G(r_n)\geq G'(r_{n+1})\Delta^2 r_n$$
